stem: In this quotation and in these lines, what does the use of imagery by BOTH the author and the poet to describe the sea creatures' eyes emphasize about the animals?

options.label: A
options.text: The animals’ ability to protect humans in the ocean

options.label: B
options.text: The constant wariness of the animals

options.label: C
options.text: The connection humans feel to the animals

visual_elements: All the while, they will appear to watch you with their large, mobile eyes. (paragraph 5, “What the Octopus Knows”)
Your eyes are always wide and kind. (lines 19 and 20, “Narwhals Are Real”)
